topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
response: MPLS provides QoS guarantees by managing available capacity, while IPsec VPNs rely on best-effort service. MPLS is preferred for large networks with strict QoS requirements due to its ability to prioritize traffic and reduce communication costs.
reference_context: MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in QoS provisioning, with MPLS offering prioritization and capacity management for real-time services.
